# OSGi FileStore

> A unified blob-based file storage service for OSGi/Karaf with pluggable backends (RDBMS, filesystem, S3), HTTP servlets for upload/download, JWT-based security, and custom URL protocol handling.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Apache License 2.0
- Maven multi-module project, 14 modules
- OSGi bundles running in Apache Karaf 4.4.7 with Declarative Services
- Spring JDBC + Liquibase for RDBMS backend, Guava for metadata caching
- jose4j for JWT token creation/validation
- Apache Commons FileUpload for multipart HTTP uploads
- Tested with JUnit 5, Mockito, Pax Exam (OSGi integration), and TestContainers (PostgreSQL)

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, architecture diagram, and API summary
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide with build commands, module descriptions, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup, branching model, and submission guidelines
- [.github/CIFLOW.md](.github/CIFLOW.md): CI/CD pipeline workflow diagrams

## Modules — API Layer

- [filestore-api/pom.xml](filestore-api/pom.xml): Core FileStoreService interface for put/get/exists/metadata operations on files identified by UUID strings
- [mime-api/pom.xml](mime-api/pom.xml): MimeTypeResolver interface for extension-to-MIME-type mapping
- [filestore-security-api/pom.xml](filestore-security-api/pom.xml): Token interfaces (TokenValidator, TokenIssuer, UploadClaim, DownloadClaim) for JWT-based access control

## Modules — Implementation Layer

- [filestore-filesystem/pom.xml](filestore-filesystem/pom.xml): Filesystem storage backend — stores files on disk in nested 2-char directories with .properties sidecar metadata
- [filestore-rdbms/pom.xml](filestore-rdbms/pom.xml): RDBMS storage backend — stores files in a FILESTORE database table using Spring JDBC and Liquibase for schema management
- [filestore-s3/pom.xml](filestore-s3/pom.xml): S3 cloud storage backend — stores files in Amazon S3 compatible object storage
- [mime-impl/pom.xml](mime-impl/pom.xml): MIME type resolution implementation using Apache Sling Commons MIME
- [filestore-security/pom.xml](filestore-security/pom.xml): JWT token creation and validation implementation using jose4j

## Modules — Integration Layer

- [filestore-servlet/pom.xml](filestore-servlet/pom.xml): UploadServlet (multipart POST with progress tracking) and DownloadServlet (GET with Content-Disposition), CORS support, configurable size limits, optional token enforcement
- [filestore-urlhandler/pom.xml](filestore-urlhandler/pom.xml): Custom OSGi URL stream handler so files can be accessed via protocol:uuid-filename URLs within OSGi

## Modules — Packaging & Testing

- [features/src/main/feature/feature.xml](features/src/main/feature/feature.xml): Karaf feature definitions — filestore-base, filestore-filesystem, filestore-rdbms, filestore-servlet, filestore-security, filestore-full
- [kar/pom.xml](kar/pom.xml): Packages Karaf features into a deployable .kar archive
- [filestore-itest/pom.xml](filestore-itest/pom.xml): Integration tests — boots a full Karaf container via Pax Exam to test OSGi service wiring end-to-end
- [filestore-reports/pom.xml](filestore-reports/pom.xml): JaCoCo code coverage aggregation across all modules

## Optional

- [.github/workflows/build.yml](.github/workflows/build.yml): Main CI/CD build pipeline
- [.github/workflows/release.yml](.github/workflows/release.yml): Manual release trigger workflow
